paragraphs.text: Avacyn's Memorial is a legendary artifact and location on the plane of Innistrad built in honor of the angel Avacyn .

Avacyn's Memorial is a memorial statue dedicated to Avacyn following her death. It was created by those faithful to her using basic materials such as wood, straw, twine, and clay. Despite this, it is considered Indestructible likely due to the faith put into it. It is built with her flying and facing upwards, wielding her weapon towards the sky. Her flowing skirt connects to the wooden base of the statue. The memorial grants other legendary permanents indestructible as well.
